name: app_flash_erase
prototype: int(int bank, uint32_t flash_offset, uint32_t len)

provenance.source: exact 4.100.179 vela_ap.bin: the bes_flash MTD 0x2007E170: up_progmem_eraseblock 0xC330DAC, up_progmem_write 0xC32D564 call this veneer (ldr.w pc, [pc] -> RAM 0x0027a40d) with bank 0 and a flash offset (getaddress - 0x28000000), each inside its own BASEPRI 0x80 section followed by app_flash_flush. Same BES SDK code as the other Band 10 Pro / Band 11 images (byte-identical apart from branch offsets).

notes: BES app_flash_erase: asserts sector alignment of offset and len, then erases sector by sector through norflash_api_erase, which completes the erase before returning (it first finishes any other module's suspended operation). Panics on a HAL error instead of returning one. Called only by the pinned-start writer, with interrupts masked (BASEPRI 0x80) like the MTD driver does. Static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
